newsitem.title: UK: NWE heating oil premiums yield to increased supply.
newsitem.headline: NWE heating oil premiums yield to increased supply.

text.p: NWE gas oil firmed on Friday on stronger IPE futures, but increased supply put pressure on low sulphur diesel premiums and heating oil, traders said.
Nov IPE futures ended $6.25 up at $233.75 on strong Brent futures bolstered by instability in Iraq and Russia and speculative buying by large trading comnpanies.

Traders said heating oil premiums were yielding to the effect of continued increased supply from the U.S. A German heating oil cargo was traded at Nov IPE +$5.25 cif Hamburg, a dollar lower than Thursday. A German diesel cargo was done at Nov IPE +$29 cif NWE, also $1 down.
An inferior quality Russian diesel cargo was done at Nov IPE +$25 cif NWE, which traders said signalled diesel's price resilience.

A part cargo of Russian heating oil was traded at mean quotes -$6.50 fob Ventspils, unchanged from Thursday. On the barge market, heating oil was done at $232 fob ARA, equivalent to Nov IPE +$3, down $1 from Thursday. Heating oil barges supplied from storage also slipped $1 to Nov IPE +$1.50.
